collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A determined bird keeps stealing a villager's hair for its nest: donate some hair, or wear a head wrap.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A small, determined bird has decided that (name1)'s hair is the finest nest material on Isola. Every time (name1) steps outside, it swoops down, grabs a strand, tugs, and flies off with it. It doesn't really hurt. It is just very, very persistent.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) combs (his/her) hair and leaves the loose strands on a branch. The bird inspects them, takes the lot, and leaves (name1) in peace. A few weeks later, (name1) finds the nest in a low tree: a little cup of twigs lined with (his/her) own hair, and three tiny chicks inside. (He/she) feels like some sort of grandparent.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) wraps (his/her) head in a cloth. The bird lands on the wrap, looks around for hair, finds none, and starts pulling threads out of the cloth instead. By the end of the week there is a hole in the wrap, and somewhere nearby there is a very colorful nest.
